evidence.reason: The finding alleged that `captureAddressProvenance` guarded only the git read, leaving `readFile(...)` and `JSON.parse(packageText)` unguarded so a missing/unreadable/invalid package.json would reject and fail the run. At the pinned tip the code already contains exactly the proposed remediation: the package.json read is wrapped with `.then((text) => (JSON.parse(text) as { version?: string }).version).catch(() => undefined)`, so both IO and parse errors degrade to undefined, and the version falls back to `'unavailable'` (`const version = packageVersion ?? 'unavailable';`). The env override short-circuits the file read entirely. Thus the failure path described no longer exists.
